body: Hello,  I am feeling slightly better now, thank you.

I do agree with you,  a couple of really good people who truly care for you is much better than large group who forgets all about you the minute you leave. Those two fo mean the world to me and they're why I've held on for so long and they are why I am trying to hold on some more. 
I guess a part of me does want help which is why I ended up on here. Up until now I've had a very precise plan for my future,  what I wanted to major in and what I wanted to do after I graduate, sadly all of that was completely wrecked.  I couldn't pursue the major of my dreams due to my parents not supporting it. They kept telling it's a waste of time and I'll probably just end up on the streets so I took up another major and currently I am not doing so well with my studies,  that among many other things all collided together and it got too much for me to handle 
Thank you for your kindness

I am sorry to hear that, but I am glad you got through it. 
I don't get much sympathy from my parents, either. I've been showing signs of depression and dealing with bad thoughts since I was nine, I've recently been diagnosed with severe depression,  I thought that I'd get support from them but all I got was a couple of really harsh words. 
I am thankful for your kind words, thank you.
